verdict.rationale: Driver openness is a fair question for a discrete GPU, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack mentions open-source kernel modules, upstream Linux drivers, or any vendor documentation of open driver support for the RTX 5080. The evidence covers only DLSS, AI features, the CUDA Toolkit and reviews.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
